question: What is the name of the weapon system engineered to neutralise threats posed by coordinated drone swarms, which was successfully developed and tested by Solar Defense and Aerospace Limited (SDAL) in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhargavastra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bhargavastra** is the name of the advanced weapon system specifically engineered to **neutralize threats from coordinated drone swarms**.
 
• This weapon system was developed and successfully tested by **Solar Defense and Aerospace Limited (SDAL)** in **May 2025**.
 
• Drone swarms pose a significant challenge due to their ability to operate in coordinated formations, making traditional defense systems less effective. Bhargavastra is designed to address this specific threat.
 
• It employs cutting-edge **AI-enabled target identification** and **electromagnetic pulse (EMP)** technology to disrupt and destroy hostile drones in large numbers simultaneously.
 
• The weapon system integrates **advanced radar systems** and **multi-layered counter-drone protocols** to ensure precision and minimize collateral damage.
 
• The successful development of Bhargavastra is a milestone in India's defense capabilities, enhancing national security against modern aerial threats.
